info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Education Enrollments Certificates-v5-spec
info.description: The Education Enrollment Certificates API provides access to the records of educational enrollments and their associated certificates. This API allows users to retrieve detailed information about certificates awarded to students based on their enrollment in various courses or programs. Typical consumers include educational institutions and administrative staff who need to verify enrollment statuses and certificate details for compliance or reporting purposes. By utilizing this API, organizations can streamline their accreditation processes and enhance student service capabilities.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the certificate information associated with specific enrollments. It provides comprehensive data regarding the certificates, which can be used for verification, records, or insights related to enrolled individuals.

requestBody.description: A request to retrieve certificate enrollment details. This request body must be formatted as JSON and should contain any necessary parameters for fetching the certificate information.
